facts: Parties: Lowther Systems Ltd (Buyer), Dunmore Marine Ltd (Seller); the Company is Ingleby Software Ltd.
This Agreement is dated 25 February 2027; Closing is scheduled for 6 April 2027 (the 'Closing Date').

Section 10.1 (Survival): the General Warranties survive Closing for 12 months; the Fundamental Warranties (title, capacity, tax) survive for 36 months. Claims must be notified in writing before expiry.
Section 4.5: if the Conditions are not satisfied by the date falling 90 days after the date of this Agreement (signed 25 February 2027), either party may terminate.

Disclosure against Warranty 8.2 (IP): the Company's core platform software was developed in 2023 by an independent contractor, Saltash Holdings Ltd. No written assignment of intellectual property was entered into.
Regulatory counsel expects merger clearance by 10 July 2027.
